name: capset_n7
note: Best known lower bound: a_7(F_3) >= 236 (Calderbank-Fishburn / Edel). Best published upper bound 288. The shipped library reproduces the 236-cap exactly (library.capset_records.record_cap(7), affine part of Edel's (248,7,3) projective cap) so the seed starts AT the LB - every trial is an attempt at a genuinely new record.
